name: Jiang Qing
source:
Number one minion of Chung Chu-Chu.

She always stands behind Chung because of her father.

Likes to bully other people for no reason.

Got scolded by Chung all the time.

"I want to play, play play, and play~~~"

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
